subtitle: 100,000 lives. One address.
new.title: A place to live. A world to change.
new.intro: Every room has an owner. Every queue has a cost. Find your place in a society that never stops.
new.capacity: Lower capacity means longer queues. Construction and businesses can change this world.
mode.survival.desc: A new resident. Earn your living.
mode.manager.desc: Own the building. Carry the responsibility.
mode.cheat.desc: Roleplay, observe and adjust the world.
life.controls: WASD move · Mouse look · Space jump · E interact · Tab menu
life.camera_help: Right-drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom · +/− change floor
work.title: Find your place
work.desc: Real work, real destinations, real payments.
work.brief: Create a clear story about daily life: establish the place, introduce a problem, show the work and end with a resolution.
network.desc: Buy from real businesses. A resident carries each order to your door.
network.offline: You need a phone, laptop or access to a public computer.
housing.title: A place of your own
housing.desc: Proximity to useful services raises value. Existing leases keep their agreed rent.
manage.title: Ownership is responsibility
manage.consent: Occupants must agree before work begins. Compensation and wages come from the project's budget.
world.created: The dormitory opens a new chapter.
end.title: This chapter has ended.
end.departed: You chose to leave the dormitory.
vehicle.intro: Vehicles are expensive; parking is leased separately. W/S accelerates or reverses, A/D steers, E enters or safely exits. Drive between connected floors using paid ramps or freight lifts. Workshops sell finite fuel and provide staffed repairs and towing.
parking.title: A place is a privilege
parking.reserved: Parking lease paid to its owner
parking.parked: Vehicle parked in its reserved bay
custom.title: Make it yours
custom.desc: Personal finishes are saved with each possession. These are cosmetic options; they do not improve strength or vehicle performance.
custom.tenant: You rent these fixtures. Linens and curtains are yours to arrange; repainting requires ownership.
custom.no_clothes: Equip clothing first. Laundry may still be in progress.
custom.no_vehicle: Buy a vehicle before customizing it. Dealership stock belongs to the dealer.
help.title: Welcome to the dormitory
help.intro: The entrance lobby has reception, food, water, toilets, shops and medical care. Services have real queues, prices and staff shifts.
help.walk: MOVE · Survival starts in first person. Resume, then click the world. WASD walks, Shift runs, Space jumps. Tab or Esc opens the menu and releases the mouse.
help.ladder: CLIMB · Walk to a gold ladder landing. E grabs it, W climbs up, S climbs down. Stop at a floor and press E to step off.
help.camera: FREE VIEW · V switches first person / observer. Right-drag orbits, wheel zooms. WASD moves relative to the view; Q/E moves down/up between floors; Shift moves faster. + / − preserves your horizontal position. Find resident centres the view without taking control; Entire floor fits the building.
help.services: Queues start at their real tail. Walk there and press E, or choose Walk in Facilities. After service, residents return to their schedule or clear the counter.
help.expansion: BUILD · Owners can fund floor expansions in Manage. A builder must travel to the site and work their shift before the extra area opens.
help.close: Continue · H opens this guide again
help.paused: Paused · Resume to walk or climb
ladder.controls: W / S climb · E steps off at a floor landing
ladder.grab: E · Grab ladder — then W up / S down
ladder.label: Ladder · E
build.commissioned: Expansion funded. Waiting for a construction worker.
build.facility_commissioned: New facility commissioned. Materials and a builder are required.
medical.title: Care comes at a price
medical.desc: Coverage funds a real crew and aircraft. A medic must reach you, bring you aboard and escort you into the infirmary. Busy or unstaffed providers cannot dispatch.
medical.infected: Infection detected. Seek care and avoid crowds.
end.died: Your resident has died. Load a save or begin again.
office.title: Client workbench
office.contract_desc: Accept a funded client brief at your workplace. Quality determines company revenue and your bonus. At least ten minutes of actual attendance is required before submission.
office.brief0: Build a data pipeline: discard non-positive values, double the remaining values, then return their sum. Your program will run against four datasets.
office.brief1: Return the distinct input values in ascending order. Preserve negative numbers and zero. Your pipeline must work for duplicate and unordered data.
office.brief2: Count strictly positive entries, including duplicates. Return the count as a single value.
office.admin_brief: Route these live local requests. The dormitory funds your administration fee; service owners still pay for supplies and repairs. Routing cannot create money or available workers.
office.ticket1: An unresolved security incident needs a warden.
office.ticket2: An injured subscriber needs an ambulance.
combat.controls: F · strike    Q · surrender    Left click · fire loaded weapon
combat.justified: Deadly force stopped an armed threat
item.desc.handgun: A firearm delivered by a courier. Requires ammunition.
item.desc.ammunition: Twelve rounds. Each shot consumes one.
ownership.title: Dormitory ownership
ownership.unlisted: The owner is not offering this dormitory for sale.
ownership.force_warning: Security must be overcome at reception. Existing crimes remain and residents lose trust.
repair.onsite: Carry parts to the site and work
housing.relocation_offer: Tenant compensation; property buyout is extra:
housing.force_warning: A replacement bed and compensation are still required. This creates a crime and reduces trust.
housing.listed: A home was listed for sale.
office.assigned: A client assigned an office contract.
resident.arrived: A newcomer arrived at the entrance.
save.recovered: The previous save backup was recovered.
trade.title: Residents’ second-hand market
trade.desc: List your spare belongings. Meet the seller to exchange the actual item and payment. Worn clothes and reserved cargo cannot be sold.
trade.listed: A resident updated an item listing.
talk.guarded: I don’t know you. Keep your distance.
talk.greet_reply: Good to meet someone from the neighborhood.
talk.job_seeking: I’m looking for work that actually pays.
talk.job_busy: I’m on shift. Let’s talk after work.
talk.job_rest: At least my shift is over for now.
talk.insult_reply: Don’t speak to me like that.
talk.apology_reply: I heard your apology. Give me time.
talk.interest0: Good food is worth waiting for.
talk.interest1: I like spending my free time with neighbors.
talk.interest2: I could spend hours at the arcade.
talk.interest3: A good film is my escape.
talk.interest4: A swim makes these crowded days easier.
talk.interest5: I enjoy browsing the shops for a bargain.
talk.interest6: I like getting lost in a book.
talk.interest7: The playground is where I meet my neighbors.
business.manager_changed: A business appointed a replacement manager.
shop.takeaway: A resident collected a packed meal from a shop.
office.result1: Dispatched. The service team still has to perform the work.
office.result2: Already handled by another team, or no longer required.
office.result3: Blocked: check owner funding, authorization and available staff.
office.result4: Misrouted. No service team was dispatched.
hud.settings_help: Language, graphics and saves. Time controls and save slots appear below.
hud.graphics_help: Distant floors use GPU instancing. Nearby beds, facilities and residents retain their detail. Software rendering uses a smaller range.
hud.controls: WASD walk · Shift run · E interact/collect · V free view · Tab menu
company.title: Companies & teams
company.desc: Build a business with your own capital. Lease or buy an office, employ residents and earn money from completed work.
company.terms: Leases cost one day upfront plus a two-day refundable deposit. Three unpaid days end the lease. Returning an office releases its employees and refunds unfinished client work; unpaid wages remain owed.
company.assigned: An employee received a new assignment
office.video_brief0: Documentary: establish the place, introduce a resident, show the queue, then work, a small change and a new morning. Reorder all six clips.
office.video_brief1: News report: open on the queue, interview the resident, establish the place, then show work, a small change and a new morning.
office.video_brief2: Campaign film: work first, then the queue and resident; follow with a small change, a view of the place and a new morning.
company.no_applicant: No willing local applicants are available.
company.name: Company name
office.work_required: Work at the desk for 10 game minutes before submitting
fire.title: Fire & rescue
fire.description: Smoke and heat injure people. Leave the danger zone or collect a charged extinguisher. Crews need a funded call, an actual shift and equipment from their station. Work at the scene earns their pay.
fire.no_escape: No reachable safe route was found.
fire.equipment: Collect equipment · public ¥40 / on-duty crew free
fire.no_station: No fire station exists. Commission one through Management.
fire.clear: No active fires. Keep supplies and crews ready.
fire.dispatched: A firefighter is travelling to the scene
fire.out: The fire and smoke have cleared
item.desc.extinguisher: Charged, portable equipment. Use within seven metres of a fire with a clear view. Pressure is consumed while spraying.
fire.error.site: An open facility without an existing fire is required.
fire.error.cheat: Only Cheat mode can start a test fire.
fire.error.contract: This fire cannot accept another response contract.
fire.error.budget: Fire response requires a funded ¥180 contract.
fire.error.equipment: Collect equipment in person at an accessible, stocked fire station.
fire.error.carried: Use the charged extinguisher you already carry.
fire.error.dispatch: An available firefighter must be on shift at their station to take a funded call.
fire.error.busy: Finish or hand over the current emergency first.
fire.error.empty_rack: The fire station has no charged equipment.
fire.error.spray: Carry a charged extinguisher and approach within seven metres with a clear view.
save.name: World name
save.browser_help: Choose a slot. Loading replaces the current session; unsaved progress will be lost.
save.overwrite_help: This slot already contains a world. Confirm twice to replace it; its previous save becomes the backup.
save.name_help: Give this world a name, then save it in the selected slot.
save.backup_help: A damaged primary save automatically falls back to its backup. You can also load the backup explicitly.
save.error.name: Use a world name of at most 160 UTF-8 bytes, without line breaks.
import.title: Import browser save
import.desc: Open an exported browser-world file (.gz or gzip .mdsave). The original file stays intact. Native limits: 2–500,000 residents, 1–2,000 floors.
import.warning: Conversion replaces this session. Save any current progress first. Nothing is written to a save slot until you choose Save.
import.changed: The building is rebuilt in the larger native layout. Identities, wallets, property, items and queue order carry over. Travel restarts; prepaid services resume without a second charge. Canceling an imported prepaid service does not refund its old payment. Jobs, staffing and later services follow native rules. New civic buildings start without cash or supplies.
import.archived: Family, pregnancy, birth, old history and experimental parameters are archived inside the native save. Those browser-only systems are not replayed. Historical deaths do not create new corpses. Keep the original export for the complete browser state.
import.ready: The native world is ready. Review what was converted, then save it in a separate slot or continue playing.
import.completed: Browser world converted to the native simulation.
import.error.file: Cannot read this export, or it exceeds the size limit (100 MiB gzip / 512 MiB JSON).
import.error.gzip: The compressed export is damaged or incomplete.
import.error.format: This is not a supported browser-world export.
import.error.structure: Unsupported or invalid browser data. Check the version, world limits and resident references.
import.error.facility: The export contains an unknown facility type.
import.error.housing: The export has conflicting tenants or invalid housing references.
import.error.queue: The export contains invalid or duplicate queue reservations.
item.desc.fan: Rest on your own bed for 20 game minutes. Uses time and equipment condition.
item.desc.tableware: Take 10 game minutes to eat an owned food pack at home, with a small comfort benefit.
item.desc.ricecooker: Prepare an owned food pack at your bed for 15 game minutes. Better satiety, real wear and waste.
personal.error.busy: Finish your current activity and use an owned, carried item in working condition.
personal.error.home: Reach your own bed first. Use Sleep / return home, then choose this item.
personal.error.food: Carry an available food pack to use tableware or the rice cooker.
import.error.destination: Choose a different native save destination; the browser export is protected.
graphics.skinning_help: GPU skinning deforms nearby bodies and clothing in parallel. Software Vulkan uses the CPU path. This changes rendering, not simulation rules.
graphics.skinning_fallback: GPU character storage exceeded this device’s limit. Switched to CPU animation.
observer.controls: Right drag: orbit · Wheel: zoom · WASD: move · Q/E: down/up · Shift: faster · V: first person
physics.error.body: You cannot move freely during this activity.
physics.error.shove: Approach an awake resident; you need energy and time to recover between shoves.
physics.body_lost: A body fell beyond the reachable structure.
help.combat: CONFLICT · F strikes, G shoves, Q surrenders. Shoves use strength and stamina and can cause fatal falls. Assault, excessive force and killing have legal consequences. Reports and recovered belongings: My life → Law & recovered property.
wash.error.dirty: Wash these dishes or cooker parts at a communal basin before using them.
wash.error.unavailable: No affordable, open washbasin with supplies is available nearby.
wash.info: Self-service · up to 4 owned dishes/cooker parts per visit. One water-and-soap kit is used; payment and cleaning happen on completion. Cancellation returns your unwashed items.
wash.finished: A resident finished washing at a communal basin.
autonomy.title: Household & decisions
autonomy.explain: Automatic residents protect rent and necessities, compare nearby sellers, arrange real deliveries, seek funded jobs and consider affordable businesses. Urgent needs come first.
autonomy.essentials: Keeping money for rent and necessities
autonomy.ordered: Purchase arranged; waiting for physical handover
autonomy.connection: Needs a phone or an available public computer
autonomy.job_seeking: Looking for a funded local vacancy
autonomy.job_accepted: Accepted a job with a real shift
autonomy.no_supply: No affordable seller with stock and delivery capacity
autonomy.shared: Shared a spare meal with a trusted neighbor
autonomy.trade_cancelled: Trade cancelled: seller, price or circumstances changed
autonomy.job_changed: A resident chose a new job.
autonomy.meal_shared: A neighbor handed over a spare meal.
autonomy.parcel_lost: A shipped parcel was lost; its unearned delivery fee was refunded.
item.desc.clothes: An owned spare outfit. Change clothes and wash dirty garments at a laundry.
talk.no_spare: I cannot spare a meal right now.
autonomy.received: Received the goods through a physical handover
structure.title: Interior & structural works
structure.help: Draw axis-aligned partitions using start coordinates and length. A central doorway preserves walking access. Projects require escrow, delivered materials and an attending crew.
structure.clearance_help: Clear homes through compensated relocation and businesses through their demolition contracts first. Remove partitions, belongings and bodies; occupants and lift journeys must clear the level. Ladders and columns remain, with floor numbers unchanged.
structure.become_foreman: Work as foreman · form a crew
structure.join: Join this crew as a builder
structure.error.permission: You do not control this structure or contract.
structure.error.floor: This floor has no usable slab, or the entrance slab cannot be removed.
structure.error.workshop: An operating construction workshop is required.
structure.error.plot: Choose a clear, supported partition line outside beds and service access.
structure.error.egress: This layout blocks a protected access or escape route.
structure.error.busy: This property or worker already has an active contract.
structure.error.clearance: Clear the floor and its protected homes, businesses, people and belongings first.
structure.error.funds: The contract needs more available funds.
structure.error.crew: A free, consenting construction crew is required.
structure.error.route: The crew cannot reach its current work destination.
structure.error.attend: Crew members must attend the worksite during their shift.
structure.error.materials: Waiting for a worker, stocked workshop or actual materials delivery.
structure.error.occupied: Someone is standing where the partition must be installed.
structure.error.changed: Ownership or occupancy changed; renew the offer and obtain fresh consent.
structure.error.replacement: The proposed replacement bed is no longer available.
structure.error.arrears: The relocation payment must cover existing rent arrears first.
structure.error.offer: Invalid compensation, buyout or replacement offer.
structure.error.salvage: Reach an owned, unreserved crate as a builder; return it to a funded operating workshop.
traffic.refuel: Buy up to 5 L of fuel
traffic.error.busy: This vehicle, road or worker is already committed.
traffic.error.plan: Choose supported clear floors and a 24–64 m ramp to the next floor.
traffic.error.lift: Stop near a served freight landing with an eligible vehicle and select its other stop.
traffic.error.route: No drivable route connects these positions.
traffic.error.driver: Reach and enter an authorized vehicle before driving.
traffic.error.disabled: The damaged, falling or attached vehicle cannot start a route.
traffic.error.exit: No safe standing space is available beside the vehicle.
traffic.error.fuel: Stop at an accessible stocked workshop pump and pay for fuel within tank capacity.
traffic.error.service: Own an unoccupied vehicle and reach or contact an operating workshop. Repairs require the vehicle at its service bay.
traffic.error.worker: A free on-shift mechanic or tow operator with an available service truck is required.
traffic.convert: Book tow-rig conversion · contribute van to workshop
traffic.error.road_work: Use Interior & structural works for ramps and freight lifts.
traffic.error.parking_plan: A 10 × 13 m parking plot supports at most two vehicle bays.
capital.intro: Each company has 10,000 voting units. The largest eligible holding appoints its director. Dividends pay all holders in proportion; wages and rent remain protected.
capital.quantity_price: Units / price per unit in cents
capital.primary: Company financing · money goes to treasury
capital.secondary: Personal sale · money goes to share owner
capital.no_offer: No shares currently offered. Ownership is not automatically for sale.
capital.buyout_info: Acquisition: the buyer funds escrow. More than 50% of current shares must approve. All holders receive the same price per unit, including minorities. The business remains a subsidiary with its staff, leases and debts.
capital.target_price: Target company ID / total offer in cents
capital.expansion_info: Expansion uses company funds, protects payroll and rent, and leases a real nearby office or commissions a supplied construction project. Automatic expansion needs proven work demand and is limited to four spaces.
capital.heir_info: Equity heir: enter a resident ID, or -1 to clear. This transfers company shares after death; it does not settle your wallet, personal possessions or housing estate.
capital.error.offer: Reserve shares you actually own at a positive bounded price; only the director can pledge them for company financing.
capital.error.trade: Reach the company counter or use a working device. Adult buyers need an active offer, available units and a different seller.
capital.error.funds: The treasury cannot fund this while preserving wages and rent.
capital.error.acquire: Choose a different eligible target and a funded, unexpired proposal. Another pending bid may already reserve it.
capital.error.cycle: An acquisition cannot create circular company ownership.
capital.error.vote: Only current eligible shareholders can vote before expiry. Approval needs more than 5,000 units.
capital.error.heir: Choose another living adult resident as the equity heir.
capital.error.permission: Only the current company director may authorize this decision.
capital.error.pending: Complete the existing company construction project before expanding again.
capital.error.expansion: No affordable clear workspace is available, or this company already operates four spaces.
capital.materials_delivered: Materials delivered · workers complete attended work
capital.materials_waiting: Waiting for real materials and construction workers
security.title: Law & recovered property
security.description: Reports require a witness, a device or a visit to a warden. Officers search last-seen locations and must carry recovered belongings to a jail locker.
security.no_cases: No known cases for this resident.
security.reported: A crime was reported to security.
security.search_lost: A search lost the suspect’s trail.
security.escape_started: A prisoner began an escape attempt.
security.escape_stopped: An attending guard stopped an escape.
security.escort_interrupted: An escort was interrupted; the suspect is still wanted.
security.error.report: Only a victim, a recorded witness or an on-site investigating officer can file this report.
security.error.connection: Use a phone or computer, speak to a nearby warden, or visit an open jail counter.
security.error.scene: An available warden must physically reach the scene.
security.error.witness: The investigating warden must reach a living eyewitness.
security.error.property: Reach the case’s property and secure its holder first; unrelated or reserved items cannot be seized.
security.error.locker: A jail property desk and an available officer are required.
security.error.claim: The rightful owner must reach the locker; some evidence remains held while they are wanted.
security.error.escape: Only a conscious prisoner with enough energy can begin an escape.
flow.help: Queues start at their real tail. Walk there and press E, or choose Walk in Facilities. After service, residents return to their schedule or clear the counter.
security.error.body: Reach visible, accessible remains to examine them.
security.body_found: A resident discovered a violent death.
security.no_violent_case: No open violent-death case is linked to these remains.
household.title: Household & mutual aid
household.explain: Up to six consenting adults keep their own beds, money and possessions. Trusted members budget for shortages and walk to share spare meals. Invitations need a nearby trusted conversation; they expire after one day.
household.error.membership: An awake adult can join only one household. Check the invitation and available places.
household.error.invite: Meet a trusted, awake adult nearby to invite them or accept their invitation.
household.error.full: This household has six members or reserved invitations.
household.errand: Bringing a spare meal to a household member
autonomy.founded: Founded a funded company and rented a vacant office
education.title: Learning & qualifications
education.explain: Classes need an on-site teacher, a seat, supplies and tuition. Finish a 30-minute lesson and its exercises to learn. One credited lesson per day. Skills shorten related office work by up to 30%.
education.error.class: Choose an available staffed school and affordable course. Only one lesson per day is credited.
education.error.answer: Reach your classroom seat during an active lesson to answer.
education.q00: Remove nonpositive values. How many entries remain?
education.q01: Double the positive values, then sum. What is the result?
education.q02: How many distinct values are in this dataset?
education.q10: Add these clip durations in seconds. What is the total?
education.q11: A film must last 20 seconds. These are its first two clip lengths. How long should the final clip be?
education.q12: These two clips overlap by one second. What is the final duration?
education.q20: There are 10 requests. Stock and the incoming shipment are shown below. How many requests remain unfilled?
education.q21: The budget is 100. The unit price is shown below. What is the largest affordable quantity?
education.q22: Each worker handles 3 tasks. Current staff and total tasks are shown below. How many extra workers are needed?
security.rescue_warning: Illegal intervention: requires owned tools and five minutes within reach. An alert nearby warden can stop you. Escape does not erase the prisoner’s charges.
security.error.rescue: Reach a restrained prisoner with an active custody record. Stay awake, free and able to work.
security.error.rescue_tools: You need usable, personally owned tools in your possession.
security.rescue_started: Started interfering with a prisoner’s restraints
security.rescue_stopped: Stopped an attempt to free a prisoner
security.rescue_completed: Freed a prisoner; escape charges remain
fire.item_destroyed: A possession was ruined by heat
education.active_help: Answer at your seat while the teacher is present. Finish the lesson to receive credit.
storage.title: Storage & household pantry
storage.description: Rent a physical locker and bring belongings to its door. Sharing is optional for each meal, medicine or garment; private property stays private. Fees go to the operator. Missed bills restrict new deposits without deleting your goods or debt.
storage.shared: Placed supplies in the household pantry
storage.delinquent: Locker rent is overdue; goods remain available for collection
storage.released: Ended a locker lease; outstanding debt remains
storage.error.rent: Reach an operating locker facility with enough money and permission.
storage.error.access: Reach the locker door and use your own or authorized storage.
storage.error.deposit: Open an authorized locker with space. Store only your carried, unworn and unreserved belongings; clear rent arrears first.
storage.error.item: The item is no longer available in this locker.
storage.error.private: This property was not shared with you.
storage.error.payment: Use your phone or reach your locker, and bring enough money to settle the bill.
storage.error.release: Only the leaseholder can release an empty locker; unpaid debt is retained.
storage.error.collect_before_departure: Collect your stored belongings before moving out. Your locker screen can guide you there.
storage.short_help: Open your locker on site. Housemates may collect only items explicitly shared with them.
crew.help: Collect materials with the lead. Helpers must reach their work positions during their shifts to earn wages. The lead must inspect the finished work.
crew.error.assignment: This crew or contract is unavailable, already assigned, or outside your authority.
crew.error.repair_lead: Assign a qualified repairer before hiring assistants.
crew.error.lead: You lead this contract. Use its material collection and work controls.
estate.title: Inheritance & belongings
estate.help: Name an adult heir for your personal property. After a death, the estate opens for review for one game day. Accepting transfers assets and their outstanding obligations. Belongings stay at their real locations. Company shares have their own separate nomination.
estate.error.nominee: Choose another living adult resident, or -1 to remove your nomination.
estate.error.offer: Only the offered heir can accept a reviewed estate while free to act.
estate.error.collect: Reach your unreserved belongings on foot. Stored goods and seized evidence use their own collection desks.
audio.title: Sound
audio.background_off: Mute when the window is unfocused · on
audio.background_on: Mute when the window is unfocused · off
audio.unavailable: No audio output is available. You can keep playing or retry the device.
audio.disabled: Audio is disabled for this session.
preferences.saved_help: Sound, language, camera and graphics preferences save automatically. World saves stay separate.
preferences.error.load: Preferences could not be read. Using defaults; the original file has been kept.
preferences.error.save: Preferences could not be saved. Your world saves are unaffected.
security.capacity_wait: Awaiting safe jail capacity · charges remain active
security.error.jail_capacity: No safe open jail has room for another prisoner
fire.freight_lost: Supply crate destroyed · unearned logistics refunded
fire.smoke_warning: Smoke nearby · move to clean air
fire.vertical_help: Smoke rises through open shafts and removed floors. Intact slabs and full partitions block its path. Upper floors may remain unsafe after the flames are contained.
